why_they_are_in_the_roster: Creates the project so she is its primary owner (cannot be removed or demoted)
A second owner: a secondary admin who manages members but is not the primary owner
Writes and releases prompts; the identity that gets the project-bound token
A second editor: proves the editor column is about the role and not one person
Runs evaluations and records evidence but cannot change or release anything
A second reviewer without the approver scope
A viewer who also holds the operator scope: the 403 names the missing project role
A viewer with no operator scope: the 403 comes from the platform scope instead
Not a member of the project: every project request is a 404
